source: Platform oEmbed checks (YouTube) run on 6 October 2026 and thecatrave Selector catalogue metadata (selector-data.json, 67,005 sets). The seven artists are the ones the essay names as cases: three from the poll's top ten or winners, four from the catalogue count. The catalogue picks the players; it is not evidence of demand.
note: Seven official uploads, none embedded on another page (grep of the repository for every ID on 6 October 2026). The page has no hero image: no openly licensed photograph was confirmed. The og card and homepage card reuse the Lot Radio photo already in the repository, a stated exception to ARTICLE-PRODUCTION-WORKFLOW.md §7.
